Anshul Kamboj | PoTM: The key for me was to bowl consistent line and length and not think about how the pitch was behaving. Wobble seam ball was working well for me. I also get good amount of bounce, so my focus is only on getting the length right.

Mitchell Santner: I think the pitch probably bounced more than expected and was quicker than usual. Bounce at Eden Park can be quite hard and after the rain it skidded on nicely. Credit to the fast bowlers for backing up.

Just like in the T20Is, India have kicked off the five-match ODI series with a win. Can they carry this momentum into Wellington when the two sides meet again on Saturday? New Zealand, meanwhile, have been hampered by a couple of injury concerns but will be hoping to have their key players fit and firing for the next encounter. Expect the hosts to come back stronger as they look to level the series. Here's hoping we have another thriller on our hands! And before we sign off, from all of us here at Cricbuzz, here's wishing one of India's finest, Virat Kohli, an advance happy birthday! Hope the celebrations are as special as the cricket he continues to serve us. Until next time, cheers from the team of Raju Peethala, Hardik Worah, Ramakrishnan MS and Siva. Sayonara!!
